AboutTagline.other: Generate test files, and know how the system under test should react to them.

BatchHeading.description: Shown in the window. Carries one value, {{.Number}}, which has to stay spelled exactly that way.

ContentsHeading.description: Shown where an archive says what it holds.

DetailBoundary.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailBoundary.other: Give the limit your system declares, as 10mb. Units count in 1024s, and the run prints the number it used.

DetailDonate.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailDonate.other: Opens the support page in your browser. The tool is free and stays free - this pays for the time that goes into it.

DetailExpected.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailExpected.other: It reaches the manifest and nothing else reads it. Leave it alone where the right answer depends on the application's own policy.

DetailGroup.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailGroup.other: It reaches the manifest, so a test can assert about a whole class of case at once.

DetailLabel.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailLabel.other: Writes into the file what it is and how big it was meant to be. Turn it off for a file that has to hold nothing but its content.

DetailManifest.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailManifest.other: It goes in the output directory beside the files.

DetailNameTemplate.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailNameTemplate.other: Left empty, the files are named after the batch and numbered, like invoices_0001.pdf. Fill it in and the name is used exactly as written, extension and all. The one placeholder is {index:04}, which becomes 0001, 0002 and so on, and a batch of more than one file needs it.

DetailOutputDir.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailOutputDir.other: It is created if it is not there.

DetailPreset.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailPreset.other: The set is worked out from the answer.

DetailReason.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailReason.other: From a closed list, so a report can group by reason. It names the rule in play whatever the outcome is - a file a byte under a size limit is expected to be accepted, and the rule in play is still the size limit. A reason needs an outcome beside it.

DetailSeed.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailSeed.other: On any machine and in any build of this tool. 0 is the seed a run uses when nobody asks for another one. It is a seed like any other rather than a request for random files, which this tool never produces.

DetailSize.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailSize.other: Units count in 1024s, so 10mb is 10485760 bytes. A plain number is a count of bytes.

DetailSizeRange.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailSizeRange.other: Two sizes with a hyphen, as 1kb-8kb. Each file gets its own size, drawn from the seed, so the run repeats.

DetailTargetID.description: The longer explanation behind the button beside a field name.
DetailTargetID.other: It reaches the manifest and the file names, so a test can tell these files from the rest of the run. The seeds are derived from it, so changing it changes the bytes.
